title: Adaptive PINNs for elastic wave propagation in heterogeneous media: code and trained networks
description: Training scripts, network definitions (Vanilla MLP, Fourier-feature MLP, PirateNet), SOAP optimizer, training logs and trained networks of the 24 runs of the paper "Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for Elastic Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Media" (homogeneous, two-layer, six-layer and Marmousi2 media), with the scripts that compute the DEVITO reference solutions, score the networks against them and draw the figures, and the source data of every plot. scripts/diagnostics/score_soap_runs.py reproduces every error of Table 3 of the paper from the stored networks. Licences: code MIT; trained networks, training logs, ground-truth wavefields and figure data CC BY 4.0.
